verdicts.reason: Both use the same scattered three-column layout: the subhead 'Every mixed case.' floats top-centre, cut off from its '20% off' headline; the CTA sits apart from the offer; and the legal line has shrunk to an unreadable ~5px. A also jams 'WEEKEND ONLY' against the left edge, and its peach circle runs under the CTA and cuts through the middle of the legal text, so that line straddles two backgrounds. B has better margins and keeps the legal text off the circle, but its circle is now a cropped stray blob in the bottom-right corner rather than a backdrop, so B is only slightly less bad.
